design_context: Expense Setup panel redesign (CR-074-B) handling category/item management with inline editing, unit prices, and bulk editing functionalities. The panel slides in from the right over the main dashboard.

html_mockup_files.description: Default view featuring a 30/70 split layout. The left column handles Category CRUD with inline 'add' inputs and hover action icons. The right column displays items with an inline quick-add row and hover action icons. Incorporates all specified test IDs.
Displays the right-hand items table with one specific row toggled into inline edit mode. Uses text inputs, select dropdowns, and save/cancel actions replacing the pencil/trash icons.
Bulk editor mode matching the Menu Management pattern. Replaces the 30/70 split with a full-width datagrid. Features dirty row indicators (green dots/borders) and omits any import/export toolbars.
Unit Prices tab state showcasing two distinct sections: 'Not Priced Yet' (highlighting missing prices to encourage completion) and 'Priced Items'.

Delete confirmation modal overlaid on the Stock Master view. Preserves specific cascade warning verbiage to address BUG-201 and uses a prominent error-colored styling to enforce destructive action awareness.

surfaces.hover_active: orange-50 to orange-100 / blue-50 for edit state

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm on cards and buttons, shadow-inner on inputs, shadow-2xl on the main sliding panel
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB (borderGray) for structural separation, rounded-lg/rounded-md for modern feel
visual_enhancers.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out on all interactive elements (buttons, rows)
visual_enhancers.indicators: Left border highlights (e.g. shadow-[inset_4px_0_0_0_#22C55E]) to indicate dirty rows in Bulk Edit mode.

grids_and_layouts.main_panel: w-11/12 max-w-[1440px] flex flex-col sliding from right over a black/40 backdrop
grids_and_layouts.stock_master: Flex layout with 30% width left sidebar (Categories) and 70% width main content area (Items) separated by a gap of 24px (gap-6)
grids_and_layouts.bulk_edit: Full-width table taking over the main content area with sticky headers

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or rounded-md shapes. Primary buttons use primaryOrange with white text. Secondary/Actions use borderGray border with darkText and white bg. Icon buttons use hover states showing primary/error colors over light tinted backgrounds.
component_guidelines.inputs_selects: rounded-md, border-borderGray, focus:border-primaryOrange focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primaryOrange. Consistent padding (px-3 py-1.5 or py-2).
component_guidelines.tables: border-collapse w-full text-left. bg-white headers with sticky positioning. Row hover states using bg-sectionBg/80.

accessibility.contrast: Maintained high contrast text choices (darkText #1F2937 vs white/gray bg). Error states explicitly use red colors + icons.
accessibility.interactive: Hover and focus states are strictly defined. Focus rings implemented on inputs.
accessibility.testing: Mandatory data-testid attributes applied to all interactive and data-bearing elements (e.g. item-edit-btn-{id}, category-row-{id}).

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use HTML native date/selects when building the React version. Map these HTML mockups to Shadcn UI components where applicable, applying custom Tailwind styling as detailed.
Ensure all data-testid attributes from the mockups are preserved exactly as written in the React components.
Preserve the 30/70 width split exactly for the default stock master view.
Preserve the cascade warning text 'This will also remove it from any associated recipes and historical expense records. This action cannot be undone.' verbatim in the delete modal.
Implement the 'dirty row' indicator visual pattern (green dot + inset left shadow) for the BulkEditor component exactly as mocked.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where necessary, but keep functional cards solid.
Do not apply global transitions that break transforms. Apply transitions selectively (e.g. transition-colors).
Every interactive element needs a hover state.
Never center align the entire app container or layout content unecessarily; favor standard left-to-right reading flow.
